title: Microwave assisted construction of a SnOx/ZnSn(OH)6 heterojunction for photocatalytic CO2 cycloaddition
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00789E, Paper

Soumita Sarkar, Soumalya Banerjee, Sk Afsar Ali, Sunny Sarkar, Astam K. Patra
The incorporation of SnOx into the ZnSn(OH)6 cube has significantly improved the optical and electronic properties of the materials. SnOx/ZnSn(OH)6 exhibits high performance, impressive yield, and high values of green chemistry metrics.
